subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: Should routed model and provider-billed cost use generic run/session metadata with opt-in reply display, or appear in every eligible response footer by default?
rationale: The upstream data and missing propagation are established, but default reply presentation and agent-context injection are user-visible product contracts that source inspection cannot choose.

options.title: Metadata first, opt-in footer
options.body: Propagate both facts through run, session, and status metadata, then make detailed response-footer display configurable.

options.title: Always show details
options.body: Propagate both facts and append them to every eligible usage footer by default.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Expose both facts through status, tools, transcripts, and UI without changing normal reply text.

recommendation.title: Metadata first, opt-in footer
recommendation.body: Propagate both facts through run, session, and status metadata, then make detailed response-footer display configurable.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans embedded runtime, session state, provider transport, and reply presentation boundaries reflected in this person's recent history.
